questions.prompt: I fear the enemy, but you fear nothing.
questions.answer: Ego hostem timeō, tū autem nihil timēs.

questions.prompt: You spoke the truth, while we kept silent.
questions.answer: Tū vērum dīxistī, nōs tacuimus.

questions.prompt: He gives the orders, but we obey.
questions.answer: Ille imperat, nōs autem pārēmus.

questions.prompt: You will conquer, and I shall die.
questions.answer: Tū vincēs, ego moriar.

questions.prompt: Longing for you overwhelmed the exiled king.
questions.answer: Dēsīderium tuī rēgem exsulem oppressit.

questions.prompt: Mindful of us, the general spared the captives.
questions.answer: Memor nostrī, dux captīvīs pepercit.

questions.prompt: Forgetful of me, you abandoned the sacred camp.
questions.answer: Oblītus meī, castra sacra dēseruistī.

questions.prompt: Longing for you consumed the whole army through the long winter.
questions.answer: Dēsīderium vestrī tōtum exercitum per longam hiemem cōnsūmpsit.

questions.prompt: No one of you fears the approaching storm.
questions.answer: Nēmō vestrum tempestātem adventantem timet.

questions.prompt: Many of us perished in that cruel battle.
questions.answer: Multī nostrum in illā crūdēlī pugnā periērunt.

questions.prompt: The bravest of you will lead the cavalry.
questions.answer: Fortissimus vestrum equitēs dūcet.

questions.prompt: The safety of all of us depends upon the consul.
questions.answer: Salūs omnium nostrum ā cōnsule pendet.

questions.prompt: We have written these things about our own life, as you asked.
questions.answer: Haec dē vītā nostrā scrīpsimus, ut rogāvistī.

questions.prompt: We think the poet erred, although many praise him.
questions.answer: Poētam errāvisse arbitrāmur, quamquam multī eum laudant.

questions.prompt: As we said above, virtue alone brings true happiness.
questions.answer: Ut suprā dīximus, sōla virtūs vēram fēlīcitātem affert.

questions.prompt: The general roused the soldiers and led them into battle.
questions.answer: Dux mīlitēs excitāvit et in proelium dūxit.

questions.prompt: Wise laws restrain the wicked and correct them.
questions.answer: Sapientēs lēgēs improbōs coercent et corrigunt.

questions.prompt: The mother nourished the children and taught them well.
questions.answer: Māter līberōs aluit et bene docuit.

questions.prompt: Time reveals hidden truths and confirms them.
questions.answer: Tempus vēritātēs occultās aperit et cōnfirmat.

questions.prompt: You drink from the golden cup, but I prefer plain water.
questions.answer: Tū ex aureō cyathō bibis, ego autem simplicem aquam mālō.

questions.prompt: Mindful of your kindnesses, we shall never forget you.
questions.answer: Memorēs beneficiōrum tuōrum, numquam tuī oblīvīscēmur.

questions.prompt: Smoke was rising from the purple flames while we watched.
questions.answer: Fūmus ē purpureīs flammīs surgēbat, dum spectāmus.

questions.prompt: No one of us doubts your loyalty, although it may seem foolish.
questions.answer: Nēmō nostrum dē fidē tuā dubitat, quamquam stulta vidērī potest.

questions.prompt: You seek glory, but I long for peace.
questions.answer: Tū glōriam petis, ego autem ōtium dēsīderō.

questions.prompt: Mindful of you, the soldier returned to his ancestral home.
questions.answer: Memor tuī, mīles ad domum avītam rediit.

questions.prompt: None of you will escape the wrath of the gods.
questions.answer: Nēmō vestrum īram deōrum effugiet.

questions.prompt: The wise man accepts adversity and bravely endures it.
questions.answer: Sapiēns adversa accipit et fortiter perfert.

questions.prompt: I praise the poets, but you despise them.
questions.answer: Ego poētās laudō, tū autem contemnis.

questions.prompt: Longing for you disturbed our peaceful nights.
questions.answer: Dēsīderium tuī quiētās noctēs nostrās turbāvit.

questions.prompt: The safety of all of us rests upon your courage.
questions.answer: Salūs omnium nostrum in virtūte tuā posita est.

questions.prompt: The orator roused the citizens and led them into the forum.
questions.answer: Ōrātor cīvēs incitāvit et in forum dūxit.

questions.prompt: We ourselves watched the star blazing in the night.
questions.answer: Nōs ipsī sīdus nocte flagrāns spectāvimus.

questions.prompt: Forgetful of us, the king broke the ancient treaty.
questions.answer: Immemor nostrī, rēx foedus antīquum rūpit.

questions.prompt: The bravest of you guarded the gate through the night.
questions.answer: Fortissimus vestrum portam per noctem custōdīvit.

questions.prompt: Fortune raises the humble and casts them down again.
questions.answer: Fortūna humilēs tollit et rūrsus dēicit.
